subject: Post-call: proposed rotating timebands for technical deep-dive (MedicoRe)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <s.lee@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call recap + three rotating timeband options for the technical deep-dive

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning, Samantha — really appreciate the context on MedicoRe's throughput targets and latency constraints for triage workflows. Recap and proposed next steps below.

Quick recap (from our call)
- Primary use case: near-real-time triage suggestions inside clinician dashboard (200–400 qps peak).
- Data controls: all PHI in customer environment, Redwood will only receive non-identifiable prompts (agreement to be reflected in MAP).
- GA timeline target: Q2 2027; pilot with one service line in Jan–Feb.

Proposed next step
We recommend a 90-minute technical deep-dive with your platform and security folks plus our runtime engineering lead to validate throughput and integration points. Because your team spans US and EU + APAC stakeholders, we propose a rotating recurring slot pattern (one weekly slot that rotates timebands) so the same attendees can join on a schedule that alternates the burden across regions. This keeps the meeting recurring (consistency) while sharing inconvenient times fairly.

Rotation proposal (pick one option):
Option A — Week 1: US-friendly / Week 2: EU-friendly / Week 3: APAC-friendly (repeat)
  - US slot (Week 1): Tue 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 UTC
  - EU slot (Week 2): Wed 15:30 CET / 14:30 UTC / 05:30 PT
  - APAC slot (Week 3): Thu 18:00 SGT / 10:00 UTC / 01:00 PT

Option B — Fixed alternating pair (US/EU one week, APAC the next) — fewer switches but still shares load

Option C — Two shorter deep-dives per rotation (45 min engineering + 45 min security) split across two days in the same week for narrower INVITE lists.

Practicals
- Proposed first meeting window: week of Nov 29.
- Attached: draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and a short checklist for infra/security questions we discussed.
- If you prefer, I can create the recurring event and pre-populate three slots; otherwise please share preferred option and attendees and we’ll set the calendar.

Action items for MedicoRe
1) Confirm preferred rotation option (A/B/C)
2) Share list of attendees for the deep dive (platform, SRE, security contact)
3) If you have any blackout dates the week of Nov 29–Dec 3, flag them and we’ll avoid.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.ai/docs

Attachment: MedicoRe_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (draft, 5 pages)

From: Samantha Lee <s.lee@medicore.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + three rotating timeband options for the technical deep-dive

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear recap and for putting together the rotation options. Tom and I reviewed this and our initial preference is Option B (alternating US/EU one week, APAC the next). A few notes: 

- Attendees: myself (platform lead), Tom Alvarez (SRE), and I’ll loop in our Security Engineering manager (TBD) once we confirm the cadence.
- We prefer an afternoon UTC time for the US/EU slot (makes it easier for our EU participants). If possible, aim for 16:00 UTC for the US/EU weeks.
- APAC week: 09:00 SGT would be ideal for our Singapore team.
- Week of Nov 29: we have a customer advisory in APAC on Nov 30, so please avoid that day. The rest of the week is flexible for us.

Can you propose two concrete recurring patterns (one starting Nov 29 and one starting Dec 6) so we can compare with our calendar? Also, if Ben/Vivek will be joining as technical leads, please flag whether you want them to present throughput benchmarks or keep it Q&A.

Thanks,
Samantha
Platform Lead | MedicoRe
s.lee@medicore.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + three rotating timeband options for the technical deep-dive

Thanks, Naomi and Samantha — Ben here from the runtime engineering team. I’ll join as the primary technical lead. Quick notes on format and what we’ll bring: 

Agenda (90 min)- 0–10m: intros and success criteria- 10–35m: architecture/ingest patterns (MedicoRe)- 35–65m: Redwood runtime overview + throughput/latency examples (benchmarks for similar pipelines)- 65–85m: integration discussion (KV cache, batching, auth, observability hooks)- 85–90m: next steps and MAP sign-off

For the first call I can drop the short benchmark slides (10m) and bring live QPS projections if you can share a sample request-size and expected concurrency beforehand. If you prefer less presentation, we can do Q&A—happy to tailor.

Concrete recurring proposals per Samantha request (two start dates):
Pattern 1 (start week of Nov 29)- US/EU weeks: Tue 16:00 UTC (Tue 08:00 PT / Tue 11:00 ET / Tue 17:00 CET)- APAC weeks: Wed 01:00 UTC / Wed 09:00 SGT
Pattern 2 (start week of Dec 6)- US/EU weeks: Wed 16:00 UTC- APAC weeks: Thu 01:00 UTC / Thu 09:00 SGT

I’ll prepare the benchmark slide deck and a short runbook for integration checklist. Naomi — I can create the recurring Google Calendar invite with both patterns and label it clearly so MedicoRe can pick which one to accept.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=rotational (placeholder)
Calendar (proposed): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-rotational-deepdive
